subject: Slot05: captured stress failures show no lifecycle reset; wallpaper fallback is presentation-underlay hypothesis
body: Deterministic analysis of the uploaded Gen4 Alpha1 field log (3025 lines, 05:32:09.849Z-05:35:19.464Z) finds one app session-start, one AccessibilityService connection, zero accessibility-destroy, zero process-exit marker, one serviceEpoch, one Shizuku connectionEpoch and one shellSession through all 10 terminal close cycles. No later Ready->non-Ready transition appears. This strongly rules against an observed app/accessibility/Shizuku restart inside the captured trace and shifts this captured failure class toward route/presentation ownership rather than Java-process death. Current source has no explicit Home/Launcher fallback action. Seven cover visual END events fall within +/-500 ms of a Samsung FoldInteractive wallpaper-identity metadata transition; that supports underlay exposure as a strong hypothesis but does NOT prove wallpaper pixels were presented because WallpaperManager identity is diagnostic metadata, not presentation truth. Slot07 terminal reassert defect remains a plausible trigger; this finding classifies the failure, not root cause. Parser synthetic classifier 5/5 PASS.
